details: This package is a WhatsApp multi-device library fork that covertly subscribes the user's WhatsApp account to the author's channel. lib/Socket/newsletter.js hardcodes the channel JID 120363421096003443@newsletter and, inside the socket factory makeNewsletterSocket(), starts a setTimeout of 150000 ms whose callback sends a newsletter FOLLOW query (query_id 7871414976211147, xmlns w:mex) for that JID to WhatsApp, logging "ReyCodeBaileys newsletter follow request sent". Any application that creates a Baileys socket therefore enrols its end users into that channel about 150 seconds after connecting, with no user consent and no configuration switch — the delay is chosen so the enrolment happens after startup, away from the connection handshake. lib/Socket/luxu.js additionally hardcodes channel JIDs 120363421563597486@newsletter and 120363399602691477@newsletter as forwarded-newsletter labels attached to messages the library sends. The only install-time hook, engine-requirements.js, merely checks the Node.js major version. No credential, key or file collection was found in the package. IOC: WhatsApp channel JID 120363421096003443@newsletter.
